notes: SF CSV is a supplement, not replacement of the original 87 route rows. Single SIM-EQ-SF shared by all 20 SF; no duplicated capacity.
Per-shift crew counts stay simultaneous persons; never multiply headcount by shift count. Day capacity scaling is a different dimension.
Same-day operations have ordinal precedence and quantity/daily-capacity workload; duration 0 is never zero resource use.
WIP still reserves original cooling resources/labor/tool pool until explicit end; at planning day1 the four WIP with end2 remain active. Historical day0 is not rescheduled.
Mapping completeness does not prove a feasible full workbook schedule or product capability. Finite shortages/unscheduled demand must remain visible.
